comments.body: Thanks for this! We're going ahead with #856 for the Voyage batching, and closing this one. Voyage's docs (https://docs.voyageai.com/docs/embeddings) give 1,000 texts as the most a request can hold. 128 is an older, lower limit. Neither PR batches by tokens, so each model's per-request token cap (120K to 1M) still applies either way. With 1,000 per batch, short route utterances take 8× fewer requests. #856 also tests the empty-list and exactly-1,000 cases.
